detail.longDescription: OpenAI rolled out a dedicated Apple Messages integration for ChatGPT to read, search, draft and send iMessage, SMS and RCS conversations on a Mac. Meta was in court fighting an EU order to let rival AI assistants operate on WhatsApp. Source: Innovation Village https:// innovation-village.com/meta-op enai-and-the-fight-for-control-of-ai-inside-messaging-apps/ # AIAgents # Meta # OpenAI
